haras-los-pellines.title: Haras Los Pellines
haras-los-pellines.description: High-impact landing page for a prestigious horse breeding operation, featuring a cloud-based automated contact form.
haras-los-pellines.challenge: The client needed an elegant digital presence reflecting the prestige and tradition of the breeding operation, along with a secure and reliable channel for receiving inquiries from prospective clients.
haras-los-pellines.solution: We designed a premium mobile-first landing page with refined typography and an optimized photo gallery. We implemented a secure contact form connected to serverless AWS services.
haras-los-pellines.tech: HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind, JavaScript, AWS Lambda, API Gateway.
haras-los-pellines.result: A fast and modern platform with outstanding load performance and a contact system that processes and notifies inquiries in real time.

languagelife.title: LanguageLife
languagelife.description: Multilingual web platform for an international language and art academy, featuring galleries and exhibition registration.
languagelife.challenge: The academy needed a multilingual website capable of presenting its language courses, artistic activities and painting galleries in a visually engaging way.
languagelife.solution: We developed a multilingual website with a real-time language selector, dedicated exhibition sections and an interactive gallery with lazy loading to optimize visual performance.
languagelife.tech: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Multilingual Routing.
languagelife.result: Successful attraction of international students and increased visibility for local artists through virtual galleries.

alex-oyarzun.title: Psychologist Alex Oyarzún
alex-oyarzun.description: Professional and refined website designed to present therapeutic services and facilitate clinical appointment requests.
alex-oyarzun.challenge: The professional needed a calm and empathetic landing page explaining his therapeutic approach while making direct contact easier and respecting the privacy of the communication channel.
alex-oyarzun.solution: We created a clean design focused on usability and visual warmth, providing detailed information about specialties while simplifying direct communication channels.
alex-oyarzun.result: A stronger digital presence, resulting in an active professional inquiry channel without intermediaries.

nico-castro.title: Nicolás Castro Photography
nico-castro.description: Multilingual artistic photography portfolio designed to showcase high-definition visual work without compromising website performance.
nico-castro.challenge: The photographer needed to display high-definition work without the image weight affecting website performance on mobile devices.
nico-castro.solution: We implemented a dark and minimalist interface that acts as a canvas for the photographs, incorporating advanced compression techniques and lazy loading.
nico-castro.tech: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, WebP Optimization, CloudFront CDN.
nico-castro.result: A highly visual portfolio that loads quickly and presents international photography work in a clean and immersive way.

fidias-place.title: Fidias Place
fidias-place.description: Interactive landing page for a dance academy featuring class schedules, pricing and online registration.
fidias-place.challenge: The academy needed an agile page to attract new students, clearly presenting class schedules and promoting salsa and bachata workshops.
fidias-place.solution: We designed a clear conversion flow with dynamic calls to action and structured schedule tables for easy mobile reading.
fidias-place.result: A significant increase in weekly registrations thanks to a clear, mobile-friendly enrollment flow.

j-avila.title: J-Avila Cleaning & Maintenance
j-avila.description: Commercial and residential services landing page optimized for conversions and direct quote generation.
j-avila.challenge: A cleaning and landscaping company needed to professionalize its digital brand to compete in the industrial and corporate sectors.
j-avila.solution: We developed a landing page focused on benefits, trust and a simplified service quotation process.
j-avila.result: Greater corporate credibility and a steady flow of quote requests from offices and residential communities.
